title: Modlimited
description: The Modlimited modpack is focused on good gameplay with no more than 50 mods, resource packs, and data packs.
body:
### Enhance your Minecraft playthrough with optimization and exploration mods (and resource packs), with no more than 50 total mods and packs, with Modlimited!

**Key features**: Explore new structures with [Dungeons and Taverns!](https://modrinth.com/datapack/dungeons-and-taverns) Get those high fps you wanted on your tomato with [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), [Immediately Fast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast), and more! Make your world pretty with [Miniature Shaders!](https://modrinth.com/shader/miniature-shader) Tweak annoying default textures with [Even Better Enchants](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/even-better-enchants), [Recolourful Containers](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/recolourful-containers-gui), and more!

![Modpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79b2d91bb86265af73dc867f878e1d2c989ddc0b_0.webp)

<details>
<summary>🧰 Updates</summary>
I will update the pack once every project in the modpack is updated to the latest Minecraft version.
</details>

<details>
<summary>📃 Credits</summary>
